# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 89 — The EMET Bible (Literal)

**Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 50 | Coptic

---

## Saying 89

Jesus said: "Why do you wash the outside of the cup? Do you not understand that he who made the inside is also he who made the outside?"

---

**Translator's Notes (EMET):**

- Parallel to Matthew 23:25-26 / Luke 11:39-40
- Thomas version is shorter; no reference to the inside being full of "extortion and excess"
- The focus shifts from moral condemnation to theological/cosmological claim: the maker of the inside and outside is one
- "He who made the inside is also he who made the outside" — implies the same Creator made both; therefore external purity without internal purity is incoherent
- In Thomas, the saying is less about Pharisee hypocrisy and more about the unity of creator and creation
